verdict.line: You lose extended trades before level 6 if Irelia lands her E (Flawless Duet) stun and chains a Q (Bladesurge) at max passive stacks, but you win all-ins from level 6 onward once Dominus is up and you've banked Fury past 50 for empowered W.

brief.thesis: Renekton's entire kit flips to a stronger version once Fury crosses 50 — Q heals and hits harder, W becomes a triple slash with a 1.5s stun that destroys shields — while Irelia's W (Defiant Dance) flatly reduces the physical damage she takes while charging it. Whoever ignores the other's timer loses value: throw cooldowns into her W and they're discounted; wait her W out and your empowered kit lands clean. Both champions also heal off their Q, so short trades favor whoever lands more hits rather than whoever commits first, which is why the head-to-head sits at an even 50.2% over 731 games.

theirWindow.when: near-max passive stacks with E available
theirWindow.what: She'll land E (Flawless Duet)'s stun then dash in with Q (Bladesurge) while her on-hit passive is capped for bonus damage. Disengage instead of trading blows here — her Q heal plus max attack speed wins an extended fight.

yourWindow.when: her W (Defiant Dance) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Commit your empowered W (Ruthless Predator) once Fury exceeds 50. The 1.5s stun and shield-destroying third slash land at full value since she has no damage-reduction window up to blunt it.

start.why: 49.7% win rate over 737 games and 84.5% pick — extra sustain matters here since Irelia's own Q (Bladesurge) heals her back in every trade.

boots.why: 50.5% win rate over 738 games and 88.3% pick — cuts down the repeated physical pokes from her Q dash and auto-attacks as her passive stacks climb.

core.why: Highest-winrate opener (59.4% via the Eclipse into Black Cleaver into Death's Dance line) — the shield triggers on the empowered auto/ability burst you're looking to land once Fury is stacked.
Armor shred stacks with your empowered E's own Armor reduction, letting your W stun combo hit harder on the second trade.
Damage-over-time conversion smooths out Irelia's burst windows from max passive stacks and lets you keep fighting through her poke.

you're ahead and want faster ability haste to bank Fury and reset W sooner

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-picked page for this matchup (35.4% pick, 46.4% win rate) — the sustained-trade healing pairs with Cull the Meek's own heal to win prolonged skirmishes despite her Q reset and disengage tools.

summoners.why: Most-run pairing (89.3% pick, 50.9% win rate) — Ignite closes skirmishes before her Q (Bladesurge) heal or kill-reset can bail her out. Flash+Teleport (8.3% pick) is the alternate if you expect a longer, split-push-driven lane.

playing.title: Bank Fury before committing
playing.detail: Trade with autos and Q (Cull the Meek) until Fury crosses 50, then commit W (Ruthless Predator) for the triple slash, shield destruction, and 1.5s stun instead of the base two-hit 0.75s version.

playing.title: Never dump cooldowns into her W
playing.detail: Defiant Dance reduces her physical damage taken while charging. If you see the charge animation start, hold your abilities and outlast the channel rather than throwing a discounted W or E into it.

playing.title: Track Ionian Fervor stacks
playing.detail: Her passive stacks bonus attack speed and, at max stacks, bonus on-hit damage. Disengage extended trades before she caps out rather than trading blow for blow at full stacks.

playing.title: Punish her E whiffs with E
playing.detail: Slice and Dice (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s CD) dashes through units for damage and Armor reduction when empowered. Look to use it right after her Flawless Duet (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s CD) misses, since she has no stun up to interrupt your dash-in.

playing.title: Force fights the moment R is up
playing.detail: Dominus grants bonus Health and AoE damage around you plus passive Fury generation in-form. Her Vanguard's Edge (125/105/85/0/0s CD) is a weaker 1v1 dueling tool than your transformation, so look to all-in the instant your R comes off cooldown.

playing.title: Respect her Q reset near marked minions
playing.detail: Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes if the target is Marked or dies to it. Don't let low-health minions sit near you when her E is up, or she can chain Q dashes to stick to you or escape a losing trade.

playing.title: Match her sustain, don't outrace it
playing.detail: Both Q's heal on hit, so short pokes decided by landed hits beat all-in commitments. Poke with auto-attack plus Q rather than dumping your full combo first.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoner spells, and the 731-game 50.2% head-to-head win rate are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch; the Fury-threshold timing and Defiant-Dance punish window are my own tactical reading, not measured stats.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out on Irelia’s (P) stacks before engaging combat. Slowly build up Fury and avoid using your skills when Irelia uses (W).
